title: Pokemon Platinum
sources: pret/pokeplatinum decompilation (GitHub): trainer data, scripts, hidden items, evolutions, encounters
Serebii.net Platinum pages: gym enhancements, Elite Four, rival, legendary and roaming Pokemon, gifts, Frontier, TMs and HMs, items, changes from Diamond and Pearl
Bulbapedia: Walkthrough Pokemon Platinum (contents and part 5, read via web.archive.org)

milestones.name: Rival Barry: first battle
milestones.tips: Barry always picks the starter that has the type edge over yours (Piplup against Chimchar, Turtwig against Piplup, Chimchar against Turtwig), but he only has one Level 5 Pokemon. Train a couple of levels on Route 201 first and the fight is easy.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum rival_route_201_*.json, scripts_route_201.s; Bulbapedia: Walkthrough Part 1 (via archive)

milestones.name: Rival Barry: Route 203
milestones.tips: His team grows to a Starly and his starter, both around Level 7-9. Walk in with at least two healthy Pokemon and a few Potions; the fight sits just before Oreburgh Gate.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum rival_route_203_*.json, scripts_route_203.s; Bulbapedia: Walkthrough Part 2 index

milestones.name: Gym 1: Roark
milestones.tips: A Rock-type team with Cranidos as the ace at Level 14. Water, Grass, Fighting and Ground attackers do the work, and a Pokemon with solid Defense helps against Cranidos.
milestones.badge_note: Coal Badge: Rock Smash works in the field (HM06 comes from the hiker in Oreburgh Gate). Gym TM is TM76.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/leader_roark.json; Serebii: Platinum gym enhancements

milestones.name: Commander Mars at Valley Windworks
milestones.tips: Mars is the first Commander and has only two Pokemon (Purugly is the Level 17 ace). Clear the grunts and her fight is short. The Electirizer lies on the ground outside the building.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/commander_mars_valley_windworks.json; Bulbapedia: Walkthrough Part 4 index

milestones.name: Gym 2: Gardenia
milestones.tips: Grass team topped by Roserade at Level 22. Fire, Flying, Ice, Poison and Bug moves are the answer; the gym floor rotates, so defeat the trainer in each area to open the next.
milestones.badge_note: Forest Badge: lets you use Cut in the field (HM01). Gym TM is TM86.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/leader_gardenia.json; Serebii: Platinum gym enhancements, changes

milestones.name: Commander Jupiter in the Eterna building
milestones.tips: Jupiter waits on the top floor behind a maze of grunt rooms (Skuntank is her Level 23 ace). Zubat is Poison/Flying and Skuntank is Poison/Dark, so Electric or Ice hits the first and Ground the second; the Up-Grade lies next to her spot.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/commander_jupiter_team_galactic_eterna_building.json; Bulbapedia: Walkthrough Part 5

milestones.name: Gym 3: Fantina
milestones.tips: In Platinum the Hearthome gym is the third one. Ghost team led by Mismagius at Level 26: Dark and Ghost attacks hit hard, while Normal and Fighting moves do nothing against Ghosts.
milestones.badge_note: Relic Badge (fifth badge bit, third gym): lets you use Defog (HM05). Gym TM is TM65.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/leader_fantina.json; Serebii: Platinum gym enhancements, changes

milestones.name: Rival Barry at the Route 209 gate
milestones.tips: Four Pokemon from Level 23 to 27, with the starter as the ace. He challenges you at the gate once Fantina is beaten. A Staravia is in every version of his team, and Electric or Rock hits it hard.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum rival_route_209_*.json, scripts_route_209_gate_to_hearthome_city.s

milestones.name: Gym 4: Maylene
milestones.tips: Fighting team ending in Lucario at Level 32. Flying and Psychic handle Meditite and Machoke, while Fire and Ground are what Lucario fears. The gym is a punching-bag puzzle.
milestones.badge_note: Cobble Badge (third badge bit, fourth gym): lets you use Fly (HM02 lies in the Veilstone warehouse). Gym TM is TM60.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/leader_maylene.json; Serebii: Platinum gym enhancements

milestones.name: Rival Barry in Pastoria City
milestones.tips: He meets you at the edge of the city with four Pokemon up to Level 36, the starter being the ace. Fight him before Crasher Wake; he is about as strong as the gym.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum rival_pastoria_city_*.json, scripts_pastoria_city.s

milestones.name: Gym 5: Crasher Wake
milestones.tips: Water team with Floatzel as the Level 37 ace. Grass beats all but Gyarados, and Electric hits Gyarados and Floatzel but not the Ground-type Quagsire. The gym asks you to change the water level to cross platforms.
milestones.badge_note: Fen Badge (fourth badge bit, fifth gym): needed to use Surf in the field. Gym TM is TM55.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/leader_wake.json; Serebii: Platinum gym enhancements, changes

milestones.name: Cyrus in Celestic Town
milestones.tips: A first, short fight with the Galactic boss (Murkrow is the Level 36 ace). You also pick up Surf here. Murkrow is Dark/Flying and Sneasel is Dark/Ice, so Electric, Rock and Fighting each hit something; Psychic does nothing to the Dark types.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/galactic_boss_cyrus_celestic_town_ruins.json; Bulbapedia: Walkthrough Part 11 index

milestones.name: Rival Barry on the Canalave bridge
milestones.tips: Five Pokemon up to Level 38 with the starter fully evolved as the ace. Heal first; this fight comes right before Byron.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum rival_canalave_city_*.json, scripts_canalave_city.s

milestones.name: Gym 6: Byron
milestones.tips: Steel team with Bastiodon at Level 41. Fire, Fighting and Ground moves are super effective on Magneton, Steelix and Bastiodon alike; Water or Grass helps on Steelix's Ground half.
milestones.badge_note: Mine Badge (sixth badge bit, sixth gym): lets you use Strength in the field (HM04 is with Riley on Iron Island). Gym TM is TM91.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/leader_byron.json; Serebii: Platinum gym enhancements

milestones.name: Commander Saturn in Valor Cavern
milestones.tips: Saturn's Toxicroak is the Level 40 ace of a short team. Psychic and Ground counter the Poison and Fighting mix. Azelf in the same cavern is a separate encounter after the Distortion World.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/commander_saturn_valor_cavern.json; Bulbapedia: Walkthrough Part 13 index

milestones.name: Commander Mars at Lake Verity
milestones.tips: Mars returns with a Level 40 Purugly. After the fight Route 211, Mt. Coronet and the road north to Snowpoint open up.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/commander_mars_lake_verity.json; Bulbapedia: Walkthrough Part 14 index

milestones.name: Gym 7: Candice
milestones.tips: Ice team led by Froslass at Level 44. Fire, Fighting, Rock and Steel are the way in, and Fire hits Abomasnow for 4x. Slide through the gym and smash the snowballs.
milestones.badge_note: Icicle Badge (seventh badge bit, seventh gym): lets you use Rock Climb (HM08 lies on Route 217). Gym TM is TM72.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/leader_candice.json; Serebii: Platinum gym enhancements

milestones.name: Commander Saturn at Galactic HQ
milestones.tips: Saturn's second fight tops out at Toxicroak Level 44. Pick up the Galactic Key in the HQ to open the sealed doors; the same Psychic and Ground advice holds.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/commander_saturn_galactic_hq.json; Bulbapedia: Walkthrough Part 15-16 index

milestones.name: Cyrus at Galactic HQ
milestones.tips: Honchkrow Level 46 leads a three-Pokemon team. Electric, Rock and Ice hit the Flying/Dark ace; Sneasel is Dark/Ice and takes 4x from Fighting.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/galactic_boss_cyrus_galactic_hq.json; Bulbapedia: Walkthrough Part 16 index

milestones.name: Mars and Jupiter at Spear Pillar (tag battle)
milestones.tips: A double battle with Barry as your partner against both Commanders, whose aces are at Level 46. Spread attacks and Electric/Water types help against the Zubat line and Bronzor.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/commander_jupiter_spear_pillar.json, commander_mars_spear_pillar.json; scripts_spear_pillar.s

milestones.name: Cyrus in the Distortion World
milestones.tips: His final team has five Pokemon topped by Weavile at Level 48. Heal before you go in (Cynthia comes with you); Fighting, Rock and Electric hit most of the team.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/galactic_boss_cyrus_distortion_world.json; Serebii: Platinum Distortion World

milestones.name: Giratina in the Distortion World
milestones.tips: You fight it in Origin Forme at Level 47 right after Cyrus. Weaken it carefully and use Dusk or Ultra Balls; if it faints or flees it returns in the Turnback Cave room later.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_distortion_world_giratina_room.s; Serebii: Platinum legendary Pokemon

milestones.name: Azelf in Valor Cavern
milestones.tips: A one-time Level 50 fight once Giratina is dealt with. Save first; if it faints, win the Hall of Fame again to bring it back.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_valor_cavern.s, scripts_pokemon_league_hall_of_fame.s; Serebii: Platinum legendary Pokemon

milestones.name: Uxie in Acuity Cavern
milestones.tips: Level 50, one chance like Azelf, and reachable after the Distortion World. Save before talking to it.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_acuity_cavern.s; Serebii: Platinum legendary Pokemon

milestones.name: Mesprit at Lake Verity
milestones.tips: Mesprit flees as soon as the battle starts and then roams Sinnoh at Level 50. Track it on the Pokétch Marking Map and catch it on a route.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_lake_verity_low_water.s; Serebii: Platinum roaming Pokemon

milestones.name: Gym 8: Volkner
milestones.tips: Electric team led by Electivire at Level 50 (Jolteon and Raichu at 46). Ground types are immune to Electric attacks, so a strong Ground Pokemon trivialises the fight. Expect a short puzzle in the rooms before him.
milestones.badge_note: Beacon Badge: lets you use Waterfall in the field (HM07 in Sunyshore City). Gym TM is TM57.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/leader_volkner.json; Serebii: Platinum gym enhancements

milestones.name: Rival Barry before the Elite Four
milestones.tips: Six Pokemon, the starter at Level 51 and a Snorlax at 49. He catches you in the League lobby before the Elite Four, so use the Pokemon Center to heal and restock.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum rival_pokemon_league_*.json, scripts_pokemon_league_north_pokecenter_1f.s

milestones.name: Elite Four: Aaron
milestones.tips: Bug team (Yanmega, Scizor, Vespiquen, Heracross, Drapion) with Drapion as the Level 53 ace. Rock hits Yanmega and Vespiquen for 4x, Fire does the same to Scizor, and Ground handles Drapion.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/elite_four_aaron.json; Serebii: Platinum Elite Four

milestones.name: Elite Four: Bertha
milestones.tips: Ground team up to Rhyperior at Level 55. Water, Grass and Ice are super effective on most of it, and Electric is useless against all of it.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/elite_four_bertha.json; Serebii: Platinum Elite Four

milestones.name: Elite Four: Flint
milestones.tips: Fire team with Magmortar at Level 57 as the ace. Water, Ground and Rock hit hard; Infernape's Fighting side also punishes Rock and Ice attackers.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/elite_four_flint.json; Serebii: Platinum Elite Four

milestones.name: Elite Four: Lucian
milestones.tips: Psychic team led by Gallade at Level 59. Dark, Ghost and Bug moves are the usual answer to most of it; Bronzong is Steel/Psychic, so keep a Fire or Ground option.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/elite_four_lucian.json; Serebii: Platinum Elite Four

milestones.name: Champion Cynthia
milestones.tips: Six Pokemon with Garchomp at Level 62 as the ace, backed by Spiritomb, Roserade, Togekiss, Lucario and Milotic. Ice hits Garchomp for 4x and also Togekiss and Roserade, Fire or Ground handles Lucario, and Electric or Grass handles Milotic. Bring varied attackers and plenty of healing.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/champion_cynthia.json; Serebii: Platinum Elite Four

milestones.name: The National Pokédex
milestones.tips: After the credits, see every Pokemon in the 210-entry Sinnoh Pokédex and show it to Professor Rowan; Professor Oak then upgrades it. This switches on the roaming birds, Cresselia's island, Dialga and Palkia, and the road to the Survival Area.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_sandgem_town_pokemon_research_lab.s; Serebii: Platinum changes

milestones.name: Cresselia on Fullmoon Island
milestones.tips: Needs the National Pokédex and the ship from Canalave City. It runs off right away at Level 50 and starts roaming, leaving a Lunar Wing on the island.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_fullmoon_island_forest.s; Serebii: Platinum legendary Pokemon

milestones.name: Dialga at Spear Pillar
milestones.tips: A Level 70 Steel/Dragon with a lot of HP. Bring Fighting and Ground attackers and plenty of Ultra Balls; carry the Adamant Orb from Mt. Coronet 4F.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_spear_pillar_dialga.s, scripts_mt_coronet_6f.s; Serebii: Platinum legendary Pokemon

milestones.name: Palkia at Spear Pillar
milestones.tips: A Level 70 Water/Dragon. Only Dragon attacks are super effective on it, so lean on a strong special attacker; carry the Lustrous Orb from Mt. Coronet 4F. Both Dialga and Palkia can be caught in one save.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_spear_pillar_palkia.s, scripts_mt_coronet_6f.s; Serebii: Platinum legendary Pokemon

milestones.name: Volkner and Flint tag battle at Fight Area
milestones.tips: A double battle with Barry as your partner against Volkner and Flint (aces at Level 58). It is the gate to the Battle Frontier. A Ground type beats both leaders' types, though Electric moves do nothing to it.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum leader_volkner_fight_area.json, elite_four_flint_fight_area.json; Serebii: Platinum changes

milestones.name: Barry's weekend rematches at the Survival Area
milestones.tips: He battles on weekends outside the Top Trainer Cafe; the first team peaks at Level 65 and rises in steps to Level 85 as you clear the Elite Four more often. Treat it as a level-matched endgame test.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum rival_survival_area_*.json; Serebii: Platinum rival weekly battle

milestones.name: Gym leader rematches at the Survival Area
milestones.tips: A building in the Survival Area hosts one gym leader or tag partner each day. The leader teams run from Level 61 to 66 and are full five-Pokemon sets.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum leader_*_rematch.json; Serebii: Platinum changes

milestones.name: Commander Mars in Stark Mountain
milestones.tips: Mars (Purugly Level 60) is the first of two Commander fights at the top of the volcano. Her Bronzong, Golbat and Purugly are Steel/Psychic, Poison/Flying and Normal, so bring Fire or Ground, Electric or Ice, and Fighting coverage.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/commander_mars_stark_mountain.json; pret/pokeplatinum scripts_stark_mountain_room_1.s

milestones.name: Commander Jupiter in Stark Mountain
milestones.tips: Skuntank at Level 60 anchors her team, and Ground hits it hard. Push on to the deepest room, where Charon is arrested: from then on the Elite Four and Cynthia use their stronger rematch teams.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/commander_jupiter_stark_mountain.json; pret/pokeplatinum scripts_pokemon_league_champion_room.s

milestones.name: Heatran in Stark Mountain
milestones.tips: Appears in the Level 50 fight where Charon was taken away, after the National Pokédex and the Galactic story at Stark Mountain. Fire/Steel: Ground and Water hit it; bring Dusk Balls for the cave.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_stark_mountain_room_3.s; Serebii: Platinum legendary Pokemon

milestones.name: Elite Four rematch teams
milestones.tips: Once Charon has been arrested, every Elite Four visit uses stronger teams: Aaron 65-69, Bertha 66-71, Flint 68-73, Lucian 69-75. You can repeat the run as often as you like.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/elite_four_*_rematch.json; pret/pokeplatinum scripts_pokemon_league_aaron_room.s

milestones.name: Cynthia's rematch
milestones.tips: After Charon's arrest the champion room uses a Level 74-78 team with Garchomp at 78. Bring a team in the low 80s and a lot of restoratives.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data/champion_cynthia_rematch.json; pret/pokeplatinum scripts_pokemon_league_champion_room.s

milestones.name: Regigigas in Snowpoint Temple
milestones.tips: Level 1, but only after you carry Regirock, Regice and Registeel to the bottom floor. Bring a weak attacker so it survives long enough to catch; in Platinum the three Regis come from the event Regigigas.
milestones.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_snowpoint_temple_b5f.s; Serebii: Platinum Regi factor, legendary Pokemon

milestones.name: Hall Matron Argenta (Battle Hall)
milestones.tips: Appears at win 50 of the Hall streak, and again after finishing rank 10 in every type. Her team is random from any type, so you need a flexible single Pokemon (the hall allows one or two).
milestones.source: Serebii: Platinum Frontier Brains; pret/pokeplatinum res/trainers/data hall_matron_argenta_dummy.json

milestones.name: Arcade Star Dahlia (Battle Arcade)
milestones.tips: She waits at battle 21 and again at 49. Her team is fixed, so use the roulette results against it. At the second meeting her team includes a legendary and the roulette is faster.
milestones.source: Serebii: Platinum Frontier Brains; pret/pokeplatinum arcade_star_dahlia_dummy.json

milestones.name: Castle Valet Darach (Battle Castle)
milestones.tips: He appears at battle 21 and again at 49. Castle Points are your healing budget, so skip needless fights and keep CP for the brain.
milestones.source: Serebii: Platinum Frontier Brains; pret/pokeplatinum castle_valet_darach_dummy.json

milestones.name: Tower Tycoon Palmer (Battle Tower)
milestones.tips: Barry's father appears at battle 21 and again at 49, the second time with Heatran, Regigigas and Cresselia. Bring bulky Pokemon with Ice, Fighting, Ground and a Water attacker.
milestones.source: Serebii: Platinum Frontier Brains; pret/pokeplatinum tower_tycoon_palmer_dummy.json

milestones.name: Factory Head Thorton (Battle Factory)
milestones.tips: He joins at battle 21 and 49 and fights with rentals, so his team is the same quality as yours. Swap in the strongest rentals after each win.
milestones.source: Serebii: Platinum Frontier Brains; pret/pokeplatinum factory_head_thorton_dummy.json

steps.title: Pick your first partner
steps.text: Choose Turtwig, Chimchar or Piplup from Rowan's case. Barry takes the one that beats yours, so a single level-up on Route 201 before the first fight is enough.
steps.source: pret/pokeplatinum rival_route_201_*.json; Bulbapedia: Walkthrough Part 1

steps.title: Pokétch and Jubilife
steps.text: Jubilife City hands out the first Pokétch apps (watch, calculator, pedometer, party status). Pokétch Co. there later gives more, including the Marking Map, which you need to follow roaming legendaries.
steps.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_jubilife_city.s, scripts_poketch_co_1f.s

steps.title: Get Rock Smash early
steps.text: A hiker in Oreburgh Gate hands over Rock Smash (HM06) and it needs the Coal Badge, so beat Roark first. Teach it to a spare Pokemon; many hidden-item and route blocks later depend on it.
steps.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_oreburgh_gate_1f.s, field_move_tasks.c

steps.title: Valley Windworks and Floaroma
steps.text: After Roark go through Route 204 to Floaroma Town and the Meadow. The Windworks building holds Mars; pick up the Electirizer lying outside it for a future Electivire.
steps.source: Bulbapedia: Walkthrough Part 3-4 index; pret/pokeplatinum visible items

steps.title: Through Eterna Forest
steps.text: Route 205 leads to Eterna Forest, where you escort Cheryl out and she hands over a Soothe Bell. The Moss Rock for Leafeon is in the forest. When you reach Eterna City, Cynthia gives you Cut; Gardenia's gym is open right away.
steps.source: Bulbapedia: Walkthrough Part 4-5; pret/pokeplatinum map_header.c

steps.title: Clear the Eterna Galactic building
steps.text: Fight up through the building to Jupiter. Afterward Cynthia gives you the Togepi egg (make room in your party first), and the cycle shop owner you rescued hands you a Bicycle, which opens the Cycling Road on Route 206.
steps.source: Bulbapedia: Walkthrough Part 5; pret/pokeplatinum scripts_eterna_city.s

steps.title: Hearthome City
steps.text: Fantina's gym is reachable on your first visit and it is the third gym in Platinum. A house next to the Pokemon Center gives a Level 20 Eevee as a gift. Amity Square is nearby once you want a walking partner.
steps.source: Serebii: Platinum changes, gifts; pret/pokeplatinum scripts_hearthome_city_northwest_house.s

steps.title: Solaceon and Lost Tower
steps.text: Defog (HM05) lies in the deepest room of Solaceon Ruins and needs the Relic Badge to use. The Lost Tower on Route 209 has an Oval Stone on 2F. Barry meets you at the Route 209 gate once Fantina has fallen.
steps.source: pret/pokeplatinum visible items, scripts_hearthome_city_gym_leader_room.s

steps.title: Veilstone and the Galactic warehouse
steps.text: Maylene's gym uses sliding punching bags. Fly (HM02) is inside the Team Galactic warehouse and needs a Storage Key to enter; you need the Cobble Badge to use it. A house in the north of the city gives a Level 25 Porygon.
steps.source: Serebii: Platinum TMs and HMs, gifts; pret/pokeplatinum scripts_veilstone_city_galactic_warehouse.s

steps.title: Pastoria City and the Great Marsh
steps.text: Barry challenges you on arrival, before Wake's gym. The Great Marsh binoculars show the day's rare Pokemon, and a man in town gives the Macho Brace if you show a male and a female Combee.
steps.source: Serebii: Platinum Great Marsh, changes; pret/pokeplatinum scripts_pastoria_city.s

steps.title: Surf and the sea routes
steps.text: Beating Cyrus in the Celestic Town cave earns you Surf (HM03). Using it needs the Fen Badge from Wake, so clear Pastoria's gym first; then the water routes toward Canalave open up.
steps.source: Serebii: Platinum TMs and HMs; pret/pokeplatinum field_move_tasks.c

steps.title: Canalave City
steps.text: Barry meets you on the bridge before the gym. The gate building on Route 218 hands out the Old Rod, and the Canalave Library has the lore books if you want the background.
steps.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_route_218_gate_to_jubilife_city.s

steps.title: Iron Island and Riley
steps.text: After Byron, Iron Island is next. Riley gives you Strength (HM04, needs the Mine Badge) and the Riolu egg once you have beaten the Galactic grunts, and wild Steelix can be caught inside.
steps.source: Serebii: Platinum gifts, TMs and HMs; pret/pokeplatinum encounters_iron_island_*.json

steps.title: Lake Valor and Saturn
steps.text: Saturn is in Valor Cavern behind Lake Valor. After his fight, Azelf sits there for a single Level 50 battle (save first). A person at Valor Lakefront has lost a Suite Key; it is hidden on Route 213.
steps.source: Bulbapedia: Walkthrough Part 13 index; pret/pokeplatinum hidden_items.h

steps.title: Lake Verity and Mars
steps.text: Mars is at Lake Verity. Afterward Route 211 and Mt. Coronet north open the way through Route 216 and Route 217 to Snowpoint; Rock Climb (HM08) lies on Route 217.
steps.source: Bulbapedia: Walkthrough Part 14 index; Serebii: Platinum TMs and HMs

steps.title: Snowpoint and Lake Acuity
steps.text: Candice's gym is a sliding-ice puzzle, and Lake Acuity opens after the badge. Uxie waits in the cavern there later, so save before you talk to it.
steps.source: Serebii: Platinum items; Bulbapedia: Walkthrough Part 15 index

steps.title: Galactic HQ in Veilstone
steps.text: Cyrus's headquarters has sealed doors; Galactic Keys lie on the floors as you go up. Saturn waits in the control room and Cyrus is on the top floor.
steps.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_galactic_hq_1f.s, scripts_galactic_hq_control_room.s

steps.title: Mt. Coronet to Spear Pillar
steps.text: Climb Mt. Coronet to the Spear Pillar. Barry is your partner for the Commander tag battle, and after it the Distortion World opens. Carry Surf and Strength.
steps.source: Bulbapedia: Walkthrough Part 16-17 index; pret/pokeplatinum scripts_spear_pillar.s

steps.title: Distortion World
steps.text: The world has no items and no wild Pokemon; platforms move when you step on their arrows. At the end push two boulders to reach Cyrus, then Giratina Origin Forme at Level 47. Heal beforehand.
steps.source: Serebii: Platinum Distortion World; pret/pokeplatinum scripts_distortion_world_*.s

steps.title: Rescue the lake guardians
steps.text: After the Spring Path, return to the three lakes. Uxie and Azelf are one-time fights at Acuity and Valor Caverns; Mesprit runs off and roams, tracked on the Marking Map.
steps.source: Serebii: Platinum legendary Pokemon, roaming Pokemon

steps.title: Sunyshore City
steps.text: Volkner's gym is a switch-controlled floor puzzle. Bring a Ground type for the fight itself, then take Waterfall (HM07, needs the Beacon Badge) toward Victory Road.
steps.source: Serebii: Platinum gym enhancements; pret/pokeplatinum scripts_sunyshore_city.s

steps.title: Prepare for the League
steps.text: Victory Road ends at the League lobby where Barry waits. Stock Full Restores and Revives, then fight Aaron, Bertha, Flint, Lucian and Cynthia in that order.
steps.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_pokemon_league_*.s; Serebii: Platinum Elite Four

steps.title: After the credits
steps.text: Walk around Sandgem, Twinleaf and the Great Marsh for story follow-ups, finish the Sinnoh Pokédex, and show it to Rowan. The National Pokédex unlocks Pal Park, Cresselia's trip, the birds, Dialga and Palkia.
steps.source: Bulbapedia: Walkthrough Part 21 index; pret/pokeplatinum scripts_sandgem_town_pokemon_research_lab.s

steps.title: Hunt the roamers
steps.text: Use the Marking Map to see where Mesprit, Cresselia and the three birds are. Switch between two nearby routes quickly until one lands next to you; a KO'd roamer returns after the next Hall of Fame visit.
steps.source: Serebii: Platinum roaming Pokemon; pret/pokeplatinum scripts_pokemon_league_hall_of_fame.s

steps.title: Dialga and Palkia
steps.text: With the National Pokédex on, talk to the Celestic Town elder, take the Adamant and Lustrous Orbs from Mt. Coronet 4F, then enter the portals at the Spear Pillar for the Level 70 fights.
steps.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_celestic_town_north_house.s, scripts_mt_coronet_6f.s

steps.title: Fight Area and the Battle Frontier
steps.text: Beat Volkner and Flint together with Barry to enter the Frontier. The Tower, Factory, Castle, Arcade and Hall each earn Battle Points for the shops.
steps.source: Serebii: Platinum Battle Frontier; pret/pokeplatinum scripts_fight_area.s

steps.title: Survival Area
steps.text: Barry's weekend fights and the daily gym leader rematches live here. The Top Trainer Cafe and a building of tag partners are on site.
steps.source: Serebii: Platinum rival weekly battle, changes

steps.title: Stark Mountain
steps.text: Mars and Jupiter fight again inside. Buck joins you in the lower rooms. Defeat them to finish Charon's story, then Heatran appears; the Elite Four and Cynthia become Level 65+ rematch teams.
steps.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_stark_mountain_room_*.s, scripts_pokemon_league_champion_room.s

steps.title: Battle Frontier brains
steps.text: Each facility's brain shows up at battle 21 and again at 49 (the Hall needs a longer run). Streaks reset when you lose; keep a team with varied coverage.
steps.source: Serebii: Platinum Frontier Brains

secrets.text: An Odd Keystone is buried in the town. It is the key item for the Spiritomb event at the Hallowed Tower on Route 209.
Draco Plate, one of Arceus's type plates, is buried in the city.
A hidden Moon Stone (evolves Clefairy, Jigglypuff, Nidorina, Nidorino, Skitty) is elsewhere in the city.
A hidden Max Elixir is outside the Windworks building. The Electirizer lying nearby is a separate visible item.
A hidden Insect Plate inside Eterna Forest, far northwest.
A hidden Rare Candy on Route 207.
A hidden Star Piece on Route 208.
A hidden Dawn Stone on the south part of Route 212 (evolves a male Kirlia and a female Snorunt).
A hidden Rare Candy on the south part of Route 212.
A hidden Sun Stone near the lakefront (evolves Gloom to Bellossom and Sunkern).
A hidden PP Up on the east side of the lakefront.
A hidden PP Up in Veilstone City.
A hidden Meadow Plate on the north part of Route 210, on the same stretch as a hidden Shiny Stone.
A hidden Shiny Stone (for Togetic and Roselia) on the north part of Route 210.
A Suite Key lost by someone is hidden on Route 213. Return it at Valor Lakefront for a thank-you.
A hidden Razor Fang on Route 214 (lets Gligar evolve at night).
A hidden Zap Plate in Sunyshore City.
A hidden Sky Plate in front of the League.
A hidden Rare Candy in Snowpoint City.
A hidden Rare Candy on Route 224, next to a Big Pearl, Heart Scale and Pearl cluster.
A hidden Leaf Stone on Route 225, plus a hidden Rare Candy nearby.
A hidden PP Max on Route 226 and a Rare Candy close by.
A hidden PP Max on Route 228, with a Rare Candy and a Full Restore in the same stretch.
A hidden Thunderstone in the Resort Area, and a hidden Nugget on the same stretch.
A hidden Water Stone on Route 230.
Six Honey are buried around the meadow; they refill each day so you can farm Honey for the trees.
The dead ends of three side rooms hide a Fire Stone, a Water Stone and a Thunderstone. The last room holds Defog.
A hidden Dusk Stone on the basement floor of Wayward Cave.
Stones in Mt. Coronet: a hidden Moon Stone on the outside north part, a hidden Sun Stone and Stone Plate on 4F, and a Dawn Stone lying on the ground on 1F south.
A hidden Iron Plate in the B2F left room, along with several Star Pieces across the island's rooms.
A Flame Plate and a Fire Stone are hidden in the second room of the volcano.
A Toxic Plate and a Leaf Stone are hidden in the Great Marsh's inner areas.
A King's Rock is hidden in the town (for Poliwhirl and Slowpoke trade evolutions).

Arceus's plates found in the field: Earth (Oreburgh Gate B1F), Insect (Eterna Forest), Draco (Eterna City), Meadow (Route 210 north), Iron (Iron Island), Zap (Sunyshore), Sky (League front), Flame (Stark Mountain), Toxic (Great Marsh), Stone (Mt. Coronet 4F), Spooky (Amity Square), Fist (Route 215), Mind (Solaceon Ruins), Splash (Route 220), Dread (Old Chateau).
Cut (HM01): Cynthia hands it over when you first arrive in Eterna City. The Forest Badge is needed to use it.
secrets.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_eterna_city.s; Serebii: Platinum TMs and HMs

secrets.text: Fly (HM02): lies in the Team Galactic warehouse, which needs a Storage Key. The Cobble Badge is needed.
Surf (HM03): handed to you in the Celestic Town cave right after the Cyrus fight; the Fen Badge from Wake is needed to use it.
Strength (HM04): Riley gives it to you on Iron Island. The Mine Badge is needed.
secrets.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_iron_island.s; Serebii: Platinum TMs and HMs

secrets.text: Defog (HM05): on the ground in the deepest room of Solaceon Ruins. The Relic Badge is needed.
Rock Smash (HM06): a hiker in the gate gives it to you. The Coal Badge is needed.
Waterfall (HM07): given in Sunyshore City after you hold the Beacon Badge.
Rock Climb (HM08): lies on the ground on Route 217; the Icicle Badge is needed to use it.
After the Galactic building, Cynthia gives you an egg that hatches into Togepi.
A woman in the house beside the Pokemon Center gives a Level 20 Eevee.
A resident of a north-east house gives a Level 25 Porygon.
Riley gives you a Riolu egg after the Iron Island Galactic fight.

Spiritomb: carry the Odd Keystone to the Lost Tower on Route 209 once the game's Underground counter reaches 32 (it counts people you meet there, so it needs link play); a Level 25 wild battle follows.
On Fridays a Level 15 Drifloon floats outside the Windworks building. It is a one-per-day single battle.
Rotom: at night, thump the TV in the back middle-west room of the Chateau for a Level 20 Rotom. It can try again daily until caught.
A resident of the condominiums swaps a Buizel for a Chatot holding a Leppa Berry.
The house on Route 226 trades a German-language Magikarp (holding a Lum Berry) for a Finneon.
A house on the west side asks for a Medicham and gives a Haunter holding an Everstone.
A house in the north swaps a Machop for an Abra holding an Oran Berry.
The room at the end of the Turnback Cave puzzle holds one item that depends on how many rooms you went through: Reaper Cloth after exactly three, Rare Bone under 15, Stardust otherwise.
If you lost or KO'd Giratina earlier, it can reappear in the Turnback Cave end room at Level 47 once you have been to the Hall of Fame again.
The Griseous Orb lies at the end of a second Distortion World reached through a portal in the Turnback Cave end room. Giratina turns into Origin Forme only while it holds it.
secrets.source: pret/pokeplatinum ov9_02249960.c, pokemon.c; Serebii: Platinum Distortion World

secrets.text: In Underground mining, odd Trainer IDs favour Skull Fossils and Fire Stones, even IDs favour Armor Fossils and Water Stones. Underground mining works solo.
A scientist at the north Cycling Road gate gives an Exp. Share once your Pokedex has at least 35 entries seen.
Old Rod: the gate building on Route 218 toward Jubilife. Good Rod: Route 209. Super Rod: Fight Area.
Shaymin (event) can change to Sky Forme with the Gracidea. A woman in Floaroma Town gives it if she sees that Shaymin in your party.
A man in a house gives a Macho Brace if you show him a male and a female Combee.
After Cresselia flees, a Lunar Wing appears on the island. It is a one-time pick-up.
A south-east house gives the Coin Case for the Game Corner.
The Up-Grade lies next to where Jupiter stood on 4F. It evolves Porygon when traded while held.
secrets.source: Bulbapedia: Walkthrough Part 5; pret/pokeplatinum visible items

evolutions.name: Kadabra
evolutions.text: Needs a link trade (Union Room, local wireless or the GTS). Platinum has no wild or gift Alakazam, so there is no in-game shortcut.
evolutions.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/pokemon/*/data.json; encounter tables in pret/pokeplatinum

evolutions.name: Machoke
evolutions.text: Needs a link trade (Union Room, local wireless or the GTS). No wild or gift Machamp exists in this game, so the trade is the only route.
evolutions.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/pokemon/*/data.json; encounter tables in pret/pokeplatinum

evolutions.name: Graveler
evolutions.text: Needs a link trade (Union Room, local wireless or the GTS). Golem cannot be found in the wild here; trade is the only way.
evolutions.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/pokemon/*/data.json; encounter tables in pret/pokeplatinum

evolutions.name: Haunter
evolutions.text: Needs a link trade (Union Room, local wireless or the GTS). A Gengar only turns up wild in the Old Chateau when a GBA cartridge sits in the slot, so on its own the game relies on trading.

evolutions.name: Onix
evolutions.text: Trade it while it holds a Metal Coat to get Steelix. After the National Pokédex, Byron gives a Metal Coat in the Iron Island house. Steelix also lives wild on Iron Island and Victory Road, so catching one is simpler.
evolutions.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/pokemon/*/data.json; pret/pokeplatinum scripts_iron_island_house.s; Serebii: Platinum items

evolutions.name: Scyther
evolutions.text: Trade it holding a Metal Coat to get Scizor. After the National Pokédex, Byron gives a Metal Coat in the Iron Island house. No Scizor is available any other way in Sinnoh.

evolutions.name: Poliwhirl
evolutions.text: A Water Stone gives Poliwrath. A trade while it holds a King's Rock gives Politoed; King's Rock is a hidden item in Celestic Town, and wild Poliwhirl may carry one once you have the National Pokédex.
evolutions.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/pokemon/*/data.json; hidden_items.h; Serebii: Platinum items

evolutions.name: Slowpoke
evolutions.text: Trade it holding a King's Rock for Slowking. The King's Rock is a hidden item in Celestic Town; use the Dowsing Machine app to find it.

evolutions.name: Seadra
evolutions.text: Needs a trade with a Dragon Scale held. There is no Dragon Scale on the ground in Platinum; wild Horsea, Seadra, Dratini and Dragonair may carry one once the National Pokédex is on.

evolutions.name: Clamperl
evolutions.text: Trade it holding a Deepseatooth for Huntail or a Deepseascale for Gorebyss. The items come from wild Carvanha/Sharpedo and Chinchou/Lanturn/Relicanth (after the National Pokédex); Clamperl itself does not appear in the Sinnoh wild.

evolutions.name: Rhydon
evolutions.text: Trade it holding a Protector for Rhyperior. Protectors lie in the left room of Iron Island B1F and on Route 228.

evolutions.name: Electabuzz
evolutions.text: Trade it holding an Electirizer for Electivire. The Electirizer is on the ground outside Valley Windworks.

evolutions.name: Magmar
evolutions.text: Trade it holding a Magmarizer for Magmortar. The Magmarizer is on Route 214.
evolutions.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/pokemon/*/data.json; pret/pokeplatinum visible items; Serebii: Platinum items

evolutions.name: Dusclops
evolutions.text: Trade it holding a Reaper Cloth for Dusknoir. Reaper Cloths are on Route 229, at Acuity Lakefront and as the Turnback Cave end-room prize for a very short run.
evolutions.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/pokemon/*/data.json; pret/pokeplatinum visible items, scripts_turnback_cave_giratina_room.s

evolutions.name: Porygon
evolutions.text: Trade it holding an Up-Grade for Porygon2. The Up-Grade lies in the Team Galactic building in Eterna City (next to Jupiter's spot); Professor Oak in the Eterna City south house gives another one. Your gifted Level 25 Porygon from Veilstone is the starting point.
evolutions.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/pokemon/*/data.json; Bulbapedia: Walkthrough Part 5; Serebii: Platinum gifts

evolutions.name: Porygon2
evolutions.text: Trade it holding a Dubious Disc for Porygon-Z. Discs are at Galactic HQ 1F and on Route 225.

evolutions.name: Eevee
evolutions.text: Fire Stone gives Flareon, Water Stone Vaporeon, Thunderstone Jolteon. Hearthome City gifts you a Level 20 Eevee; wild ones need the National Pokédex.

evolutions.name: Eevee
evolutions.text: Level up with high friendship (220 or more) in the daytime (04:00-19:59) for Espeon, or at night (20:00-03:59) for Umbreon. Soothe Bell and the Friendship Checker app help.

evolutions.name: Eevee
evolutions.text: Level up in Eterna Forest (near the Moss Rock) for Leafeon, or on Route 217 (near the Ice Rock) for Glaceon. Both rocks are fixed in the map, not an item.

evolutions.name: Pikachu
evolutions.text: Thunderstone gives Raichu. Thunderstones: Sunyshore City (on the ground), Solaceon Ruins SE dead end and Resort Area (hidden), or Underground mining.
evolutions.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/pokemon/*/data.json; hidden_items.h; Serebii: Platinum items

evolutions.name: Clefairy
evolutions.text: A Moon Stone gives Clefable. Hidden Moon Stones: Eterna City and the north side of Mt. Coronet; also Underground mining.
evolutions.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/pokemon/*/data.json; hidden_items.h; Serebii: Platinum items

evolutions.name: Jigglypuff
evolutions.text: A Moon Stone gives Wigglytuff. See Clefairy for where Moon Stones are.

evolutions.name: Nidorina
evolutions.text: A Moon Stone gives Nidoqueen. Hidden Moon Stones: Eterna City and the north side of Mt. Coronet.

evolutions.name: Nidorino
evolutions.text: A Moon Stone gives Nidoking. Hidden Moon Stones: Eterna City and the north side of Mt. Coronet.

evolutions.name: Skitty
evolutions.text: A Moon Stone gives Delcatty. Hidden Moon Stones: Eterna City and the north side of Mt. Coronet.

evolutions.name: Growlithe
evolutions.text: A Fire Stone gives Arcanine. Fire Stones: Fuego Ironworks (on the ground), Solaceon Ruins and Stark Mountain (hidden), and Underground mining.
evolutions.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/pokemon/*/data.json; hidden_items.h; pret/pokeplatinum visible items

evolutions.name: Vulpix
evolutions.text: A Fire Stone gives Ninetales. Fire Stones: Fuego Ironworks, Solaceon Ruins, Stark Mountain, Underground mining.

evolutions.name: Gloom
evolutions.text: A Leaf Stone gives Vileplume; a Sun Stone gives Bellossom. Leaf Stones: Floaroma Meadow, hidden in the Great Marsh and on Route 225. Sun Stones: hidden at Valor Lakefront and Mt. Coronet 4F.
evolutions.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/pokemon/*/data.json; hidden_items.h; pret/pokeplatinum visible items

evolutions.name: Weepinbell
evolutions.text: A Leaf Stone gives Victreebel. Leaf Stones: Floaroma Meadow, the Great Marsh, Route 225.

evolutions.name: Exeggcute
evolutions.text: A Leaf Stone gives Exeggutor. Leaf Stones: Floaroma Meadow, the Great Marsh, Route 225.

evolutions.name: Nuzleaf
evolutions.text: A Leaf Stone gives Shiftry. Leaf Stones: Floaroma Meadow, the Great Marsh, Route 225.

evolutions.name: Lombre
evolutions.text: A Water Stone gives Ludicolo. Water Stones: Route 213 (ground), Solaceon Ruins and Route 230 (hidden), Underground mining.
evolutions.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/pokemon/*/data.json; hidden_items.h; pret/pokeplatinum visible items

evolutions.name: Shellder
evolutions.text: A Water Stone gives Cloyster. Water Stones: Route 213, Solaceon Ruins, Route 230, Underground mining.

evolutions.name: Staryu
evolutions.text: A Water Stone gives Starmie. Water Stones: Route 213, Solaceon Ruins, Route 230, Underground mining.

evolutions.name: Sunkern
evolutions.text: A Sun Stone gives Sunflora. Sun Stones are hidden at Valor Lakefront and Mt. Coronet 4F, and turn up in Underground mining.

evolutions.name: Misdreavus
evolutions.text: A Dusk Stone gives Mismagius. Dusk Stones: the Veilstone Galactic warehouse, Victory Road 1F, and hidden in Wayward Cave B1F.
evolutions.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/pokemon/*/data.json; hidden_items.h; pret/pokeplatinum visible items

evolutions.name: Murkrow
evolutions.text: A Dusk Stone gives Honchkrow. Dusk Stones: the Veilstone Galactic warehouse, Victory Road 1F, Wayward Cave B1F (hidden).

evolutions.name: Kirlia
evolutions.text: Only a male Kirlia becomes Gallade, with a Dawn Stone; a female Kirlia (or any Kirlia at Level 30) becomes Gardevoir. Dawn Stones: Mt. Coronet 1F south, Route 225 (ground) and Route 212 south (hidden).

evolutions.name: Snorunt
evolutions.text: A female Snorunt becomes Froslass with a Dawn Stone; a male still goes to Glalie at Level 42. Dawn Stones: Mt. Coronet 1F south, Route 225, Route 212 south (hidden).

evolutions.name: Roselia
evolutions.text: A Shiny Stone gives Roserade. Shiny Stones: Iron Island B3F and Route 228 (ground), Route 210 north (hidden).

evolutions.name: Togepi
evolutions.text: Level up with friendship of 220 or more to get Togetic. Cynthia gives you the Togepi egg in Eterna City after the Galactic building.

evolutions.name: Togetic
evolutions.text: A Shiny Stone gives Togekiss. Shiny Stones: Iron Island B3F and Route 228 (ground), Route 210 north (hidden).

evolutions.name: Happiny
evolutions.text: Level up while holding an Oval Stone during the day (04:00-19:59) to get Chansey. An Oval Stone is on the ground in the Lost Tower (Route 209, 2F).
evolutions.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/pokemon/*/data.json; pret/pokeplatinum visible items, rtc.c

evolutions.name: Chansey
evolutions.text: Level up with friendship of 220 or more for Blissey.

evolutions.name: Riolu
evolutions.text: Level up with friendship of 220 or more in the daytime (04:00-19:59). The Riolu egg comes from Riley on Iron Island.

evolutions.name: Munchlax
evolutions.text: Level up with friendship of 220 or more to become Snorlax.

evolutions.name: Golbat
evolutions.text: Level up with friendship of 220 or more to become Crobat.

evolutions.name: Cleffa
evolutions.text: Level up with high friendship to become Clefairy.

evolutions.name: Igglybuff
evolutions.text: Level up with high friendship to become Jigglypuff.

evolutions.name: Pichu
evolutions.text: Level up with high friendship to become Pikachu. Wild Pichu live in the Trophy Garden next to Route 212.
evolutions.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/pokemon/*/data.json; Serebii: Platinum Trophy Garden

evolutions.name: Azurill
evolutions.text: Level up with high friendship to become Marill.

evolutions.name: Buneary
evolutions.text: Level up with high friendship to become Lopunny.

evolutions.name: Budew
evolutions.text: Level up with high friendship in the daytime (04:00-19:59) to become Roselia.

evolutions.name: Chingling
evolutions.text: Level up with high friendship at night (20:00-03:59) to become Chimecho.

evolutions.name: Magneton
evolutions.text: Level up anywhere inside Mt. Coronet (every floor, the outside parts, and Spear Pillar) to become Magnezone.

evolutions.name: Nosepass
evolutions.text: Level up anywhere inside Mt. Coronet to become Probopass.

evolutions.name: Sneasel
evolutions.text: Level up while holding a Razor Claw at night (20:00-03:59) to get Weavile. Razor Claws lie on Victory Road 1F and Route 224.
evolutions.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/pokemon/*/data.json; pret/pokeplatinum rtc.c, visible items

evolutions.name: Gligar
evolutions.text: Level up while holding a Razor Fang at night to get Gliscor. A Razor Fang is on Route 225 (ground) and hidden on Route 214.
evolutions.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/pokemon/*/data.json; pret/pokeplatinum visible items, hidden_items.h

evolutions.name: Feebas
evolutions.text: Becomes Milotic by level-up when its Beauty condition is high (170 or more). Feed it Poffins made for the Beauty stat.

evolutions.name: Tyrogue
evolutions.text: At Level 20 it becomes Hitmonlee if Attack is higher than Defense, Hitmonchan if lower, Hitmontop if equal.

evolutions.name: Mime Jr.
evolutions.text: Level up while knowing Mimic to become Mr. Mime. It does not evolve by level alone.

evolutions.name: Bonsly
evolutions.text: Level up while knowing Mimic to become Sudowoodo.

evolutions.name: Aipom
evolutions.text: Level up while knowing Double Hit to become Ambipom.

evolutions.name: Lickitung
evolutions.text: Level up while knowing Rollout to become Lickilicky.

evolutions.name: Tangela
evolutions.text: Level up while knowing AncientPower to become Tangrowth. Tangela is a wild Pokémon in Platinum only (Diamond and Pearl lack it).
evolutions.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/pokemon/*/data.json; pret/pokeplatinum pokemon.c; Serebii: Platinum exclusives

evolutions.name: Yanma
evolutions.text: Level up while knowing AncientPower to become Yanmega.

evolutions.name: Piloswine
evolutions.text: Level up while knowing AncientPower to become Mamoswine.

evolutions.name: Mantyke
evolutions.text: Level up while a Remoraid is in your party to become Mantine.

evolutions.name: Burmy
evolutions.text: At Level 20 a female becomes Wormadam and a male Mothim. Burmy's cloak is set by where it last fought: grass battles give Plant, caves/mountains/plains/sand give Sandy, buildings and bridges give Trash. Wormadam keeps that cloak.

evolutions.name: Combee
evolutions.text: Only females evolve (Level 21 into Vespiquen). Show a male and a female Combee to the man in Pastoria City for the Macho Brace.

evolutions.name: Nincada
evolutions.text: At Level 20 it becomes Ninjask; with an empty party slot and a Poke Ball in the bag, a Shedinja also appears.

evolutions.name: Wurmple
evolutions.text: At Level 7 it becomes Silcoon or Cascoon, decided by a hidden personality value you cannot choose.

notes.title: Gym order differs from Diamond and Pearl
notes.text: Platinum's gym order is Roark, Gardenia, Fantina, Maylene, Crasher Wake, Byron, Candice, Volkner. The badge bits still follow the old order (Coal, Forest, Cobble, Fen, Relic, Mine, Icicle, Beacon), so Fantina's Relic Badge is the fifth bit but the third gym.
notes.source: Serebii: Platinum changes; pret/pokeplatinum generated/badges.txt, GiveBadge scripts

notes.title: Which badge each field move needs
notes.text: Cut: Forest. Fly: Cobble. Surf: Fen. Strength: Mine. Defog: Relic. Rock Smash: Coal. Waterfall: Beacon. Rock Climb: Icicle. Because Platinum swaps the gym order, Fly comes sooner and Defog later than in Diamond and Pearl.
notes.source: pret/pokeplatinum src/field_move_tasks.c

notes.title: Platinum-only forms
notes.text: Platinum adds Rotom's appliance forms, Giratina's Origin Forme and Shaymin's Sky Forme. Each form needs its own trigger: an event item for Rotom, the Griseous Orb for Giratina, and the Gracidea for Shaymin.
notes.source: Serebii: Platinum changes, exclusives; pret/pokeplatinum pokemon.c

notes.title: Wild Pokémon only in Platinum
notes.text: Among the Sinnoh games, Platinum alone has wild Tangela, Tropius, Articuno, Zapdos, Moltres, and (via the event Regigigas) Regirock, Regice and Registeel. Tangrowth comes from Tangela.
notes.source: Serebii: Platinum exclusives

notes.title: Articuno, Zapdos and Moltres roam
notes.text: After the National Pokédex, visit Professor Oak in the Eterna City south house to start all three roaming at Level 60. Use the Marking Map app, switch between two routes until one lands beside you, and catch it. A fainted bird comes back after the next Hall of Fame entry or another talk with Oak.
notes.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_eterna_city_south_house.s, scripts_pokemon_league_hall_of_fame.s; Serebii: Platinum roaming

notes.title: Mesprit roams after Lake Verity
notes.text: Mesprit appears at Lake Verity after Giratina and flees on the first turn. It roams at Level 50; the Marking Map shows its route. If it faints it is reset after the next Hall of Fame entry.
notes.source: Serebii: Platinum roaming Pokemon; pret/pokeplatinum scripts_pokemon_league_hall_of_fame.s

notes.title: Cresselia roams after Fullmoon Island
notes.text: With the National Pokédex, take the Canalave ship to Fullmoon Island. Cresselia leaves immediately, then roams at Level 50, leaving a Lunar Wing behind. A KO'd Cresselia returns after the next Hall of Fame entry.
notes.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_fullmoon_island_forest.s; Serebii: Platinum legendary Pokemon

notes.title: Giratina
notes.text: Level 47 in the Distortion World; after the Hall of Fame you can meet it again in the Turnback Cave end room if you missed it. Origin Forme only lasts while it holds the Griseous Orb. Entering the Union Room or other link rooms in a Pokémon Center moves the orb into your bag (keep a free slot) and sends Giratina, Rotom and Shaymin back to their base forms.
notes.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_distortion_world_giratina_room.s, scripts_pokemon_center_2f_common.s; Serebii: Platinum Distortion World

notes.title: Dialga and Palkia
notes.text: After the National Pokédex, talk to the elder in Celestic Town, take the Adamant Orb (Dialga) and Lustrous Orb (Palkia) from Mt. Coronet 4F, then use the portals on the Spear Pillar. Both are Level 70. If one faints, finish the Hall of Fame again to restore it.
notes.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_mt_coronet_6f.s, scripts_pokemon_league_hall_of_fame.s; Serebii: Platinum legendary Pokemon

notes.title: Uxie and Azelf
notes.text: Both are one-time Level 50 fights in their caverns after the Distortion World. Save beforehand; if they faint, entering the Hall of Fame again returns them.
notes.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_acuity_cavern.s, scripts_valor_cavern.s; Serebii: Platinum legendary Pokemon

notes.title: Heatran
notes.text: A Level 50 fight in Stark Mountain after the National Pokédex and the Galactic story there. A fainted Heatran returns after the Hall of Fame.
notes.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_stark_mountain_room_3.s; Serebii: Platinum legendary Pokemon

notes.title: Regigigas needs the three Regis
notes.text: Regigigas sleeps at Level 1 in Snowpoint Temple and wakes only when Regirock, Regice and Registeel are all in your party. In Platinum the Regis come from the event Regigigas (caves on Route 228, Mt. Coronet near Route 216 and Iron Island) or from a trade/transfer.
notes.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_snowpoint_temple_b5f.s; Serebii: Platinum Regi factor

notes.title: Darkrai (event item needed)
notes.text: Newmoon Island opens by sleeping in the locked Canalave inn, which needs the Member Card from a past Mystery Gift. The Level 50 fight is on the island.
notes.source: Serebii: Platinum legendary Pokemon; pret/pokeplatinum scripts_newmoon_island_forest.s

notes.title: Shaymin (event item needed)
notes.text: Oak's Letter from a past Mystery Gift lets you find Shaymin at Level 30 in Flower Paradise. Afterward the Gracidea from Floaroma Town turns it into Sky Forme, but only in the daytime (04:00-19:59), and it reverts when frozen or at night.
notes.source: Serebii: Platinum legendary Pokemon; pret/pokeplatinum pokemon.c, scripts_flower_paradise.s

notes.title: Arceus (event item needed)
notes.text: The Azure Flute from a past Mystery Gift is played at the Spear Pillar to reach the Hall of Origin. Arceus is a Level 80 fight.
notes.source: Serebii: Platinum legendary Pokemon; pret/pokeplatinum scripts_hall_of_origin.s

notes.title: Rotom and its forms
notes.text: Rotom (Level 20) is in the Old Chateau TV at night, once a day until caught. The appliance forms need the Secret Key from a Mystery Gift: use it behind the Eterna Galactic building wall, then pick an appliance. Heat, Wash, Frost, Fan and Mow each teach a special move.
notes.source: Serebii: Platinum Rotom Factor; pret/pokeplatinum scripts_rotoms_room.s, scripts_old_chateau_back_middle_west_room.s

notes.title: In-game gift Pokémon
notes.text: Togepi egg (Cynthia, Eterna City, after the Galactic building), Level 20 Eevee (Hearthome City), Level 25 Porygon (Veilstone City), Riolu egg (Riley, Iron Island). Togepi, Eevee and Porygon cannot be found in the wild until later.
notes.source: Serebii: Platinum gifts; pret/pokeplatinum gift scripts

notes.title: In-game trades
notes.text: Four NPCs trade: Buizel for Chatot (Eterna City), Finneon for a German Magikarp (Route 226), Medicham for Haunter holding Everstone (Snowpoint City) and Machop for Abra (Oreburgh City).
notes.source: pret/pokeplatinum res/npc_trades/*.json

notes.title: Friday Drifloon
notes.text: On Fridays a Level 15 Drifloon waits outside Valley Windworks; it is a single battle per day.
notes.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_valley_windworks_outside.s

notes.title: Spiritomb
notes.text: The hidden Odd Keystone in Twinleaf Town, a visit to the Lost Tower on Route 209, and the game's Spiritomb counter reaching 32 (it advances through Underground activity) lead to a Level 25 Spiritomb fight.
notes.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_route_209.s, hidden_items.h

notes.title: Hall of Fame restores missed legendaries
notes.text: Entering the Hall of Fame again puts an uncaught Dialga, Palkia, Heatran, Regigigas, Azelf, Uxie or Giratina back where it was, and resets roamers you fainted. Save before each encounter.
notes.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_pokemon_league_hall_of_fame.s

notes.title: Elite Four and Cynthia rematch switch
notes.text: The Elite Four and Cynthia use their stronger teams (Level 65-78) from the moment Charon is arrested in Stark Mountain. Finish the Stark Mountain story first, then challenge the League again.
notes.source: pret/pokeplatinum scripts_pokemon_league_aaron_room.s, scripts_pokemon_league_champion_room.s

notes.title: Battle Frontier basics
notes.text: The Frontier at the Fight Area has five facilities (Tower, Factory, Castle, Arcade, Hall). Most modes default to Level 50 (the Tower can also use your highest level, the Factory also Level 100). Battle Points buy items and TMs in the shops.
notes.source: Serebii: Platinum Battle Frontier

notes.title: Day and night in Platinum
notes.text: The game counts 04:00-19:59 as day and 20:00-03:59 as night. Time-based events (Rotom, night evolutions, Gracidea) follow the DS clock, so the emulator's real-time setting matters.
notes.source: pret/pokeplatinum src/rtc.c

notes.title: Gym TMs
notes.text: Roark TM76, Gardenia TM86, Fantina TM65, Maylene TM60, Wake TM55, Byron TM91, Candice TM72, Volkner TM57.
notes.source: pret/pokeplatinum gym scripts

notes.title: Daily rematch trainers
notes.text: Pokémon Centers across Sinnoh host trainers who can be rebattled each day, and their levels follow your progress. The Survival Area also hosts a different gym leader each day.
notes.source: Serebii: Platinum changes
